_comment: Does `overflow` clip, and does the clip follow the PADDING-BOX curve? css-overflow-3 §2.2 puts the clip at the overflow clip edge (the padding edge by default); css-backgrounds-3 §5.3 gives that edge its curve: the inner radius is the outer radius MINUS the corresponding border width, floored at 0. This is the classic three-way divergence — Compose clips with a Shape, SwiftUI with .clipShape/.clipped, DOM with overflow+border-radius — and none of it is exercised today: fixtures/properties/effects/overflow.json has 17 components and NOT ONE has content that overflows, so all 17 are degenerate (case == control, the same weakness STATUS.md records for TextOverflow_Ellipsis). Construction: every component is a parent carrying the variable plus ONE child, keyed `fill` in every component, sized to exactly fill the parent's padding box. The child is what gets clipped. Two consequences worth knowing: a parent WITH children draws no synthesized name label (runtimes/web/src/renderer/NodeRenderer.ts:223 vs :330), and every child label is the identical string FILL, so cross-component byte comparisons in this file are valid. Colours: parent teal #1abc9c, child red #e74c3c, border yellow #f1c40f, canvas #1A1A2E. The parent's teal is a DIAGNOSTIC, not scenery — the child covers the padding box exactly, so teal must never be visible; teal at a corner means the platform clipped the child but not the parent's own background. MUST MATCH byte-for-byte: OCR_Hidden_R30 == OCR_Clip_R30, and OCR_Visible_R30 == OCR_Hidden_R0. MUST DIFFER: OCR_Hidden_R30 vs OCR_Visible_R30 (~772 px), OCR_Hidden_InnerCurve vs OCR_Visible_InnerCurve (~343 px).

OCR_Hidden_R30._note: 160x60 box, r=30. §5.2 scaling factor is 1 (adjacent sums 60 <= 160 horizontally and 60 <= 60 vertically), so the ends are exact semicircles. EXPECTED: red stadium; each corner loses r^2 - pi*r^2/4 = 900 - 706.86 = 193.14 px to the canvas colour, 772.6 px over four corners. Sample (2,2) = canvas #1A1A2E (outside the arc), (2,30) = red (the arc reaches x=0 at mid-height), (80,30) = red.

OCR_Visible_R30._note: Identical except `overflow: visible` (the CSS 2.1 §11.1.1 initial value). EXPECTED: the child's SQUARE 160x60 paints over the parent's rounded corners, so (2,2) = red. Differs from OCR_Hidden_R30 by the 772.6 px of corner. If it does NOT differ, this platform clips unconditionally and `overflow` is inert.

OCR_Clip_R30._note: `overflow: clip` (css-overflow-3 §3.2) clips at the same overflow clip edge as `hidden` and differs only in scrollability, which no static capture can see. EXPECTED: byte-identical to OCR_Hidden_R30. A difference means one of the two keywords took a different paint path.

OCR_Hidden_R0._note: `overflow: hidden` with r=0 — clipping still happens, but to a square. EXPECTED: byte-identical to OCR_Visible_R30 (a full red 160x60). Pairing these two separates 'the clip happens' from 'the clip uses border-radius': a platform that clips but ignores the radius renders all four of OCR_Hidden_R30/Visible_R30/Clip_R30/Hidden_R0 the same.

OCR_Hidden_InnerCurve._note: The §5.3 arithmetic. box-sizing is content-box, so width:160/height:80 plus a 10px border gives a 180x100 border box and a 160x80 padding box at (10,10). Inner radius = 30 - 10 = 20. EXPECTED: 10px yellow ring with a 30px outer curve; red 160x80 inside with 20px corners, losing 400 - 314.16 = 85.84 px per corner. DISCRIMINATOR: a platform that reuses the OUTER 30px for the clip loses 193.14 px per corner instead (yellow visible where red should be); one that uses 0 leaves the red corners square.

OCR_Visible_InnerCurve._note: Identical except `overflow: visible`. EXPECTED: red SQUARE 160x80 at (10,10) painting over the border's inner curve. Differs from OCR_Hidden_InnerCurve by 4 * 85.84 = 343.4 px. Zero difference means the inner curve never reached the clip.

OCR_Hidden_ZeroFloor._note: The floor half of §5.3: border 40px, outer radius 20px, so the inner radius is max(0, 20 - 40) = 0. Border box 160x120, padding box 80x40 at (40,40). EXPECTED: a SHARP red 80x40 rectangle inside a yellow ring whose outer corners are 20px. DISCRIMINATOR: any rounding at all on the red rectangle means the max(0, ...) floor is missing (|20-40| = 20 and clamp-to-20 both round it).
